blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Sandiganbayan has allowed the withdrawal of a Safe Spaces Act case against an Army colonel, ruling that the case should instead be filed before a Regional Trial Court (RTC). In a resolution promulgated on Oct. 21 and posted on the anti-graft court’s website on Friday, its Third Division granted special prosecutors’ Motion to Withdraw Information on the case of Col. Roy Papica Abad, who was charged with violation of the Republic Act No. 11313, or the Safe Spaces Act.
